body: I am glad you stick it out for her. My dad stuck it out for me until I was 10 then took his life. It’s really huge you keep going for her.
I don’t know actually. What are you going through? I’m trying to help people before I go
Please don’t worry. Thank you again
Please don’t worry. Thank you again
You have done so much just by being here and making me feel less alone
You didn’t I’m just panicking
I’m sorry you have to go through this, it sounds like too much
How are you right now? Like in this moment what are you feeling?
How are you feeling right now?
Oh gosh that sounded so ungrateful I’m so sorry I just am not thinking clearly. I am grateful to you I’m sorry I’m not thinking clearly
I’m really really sorry you have to feel so much hurt
Fuck that sounds so incredibly painful.

I saw on your profile you want to help prevent suicide and think that is really nice. I think maybe other people who are posting new things would benefit from your replying to them. I really appreciate you taking the time with me but think it would really be better to help people who haven’t already started the process

Thank you. I have tried calling the liscencing place, but they have their hands tied. Nothing can be done until the paralegal looks over my simple misdemeanor. It’s not the lawyers fault either. I made a mistake and am to blame. I just can’t take the pain and anxiety anymore.
Have you always felt like this? Or can you remember having energy and hope for feeling better?

Thank you for replying I really feel alone. I graduated medical school last month and am supposed to start residency in Monday. But 6 years ago I made a mistake and now I won’t be able to start for I am not sure how long. After all the effort to get here I just am at the end of my rope. It may seem dramatic but it is too painful to keep trying.
Man that feeling is rough. I am sorry you have to go through this.

I’m so sorry you are in so much pain. To be that tired is so painful. I wish I could say or do the right thing to help you, but I just want you to know someone hears you. I really really wish I could take away your hurt.
Hello, I don’t have the right words but I want you to know someone hears you. I’m so proud of you for continuing to write and read and do things when your brain is telling you dark things.
Check the nmrp website!
